## Crosstables

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)

# --- 1) Start from your subset (adds types you wanted) ---
bdnf_subset <- bdnf %>%
  select(ID, Standort, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel,
         CpG_position, rauchen, methylierung) %>%
  mutate(
    ID            = as.factor(ID),
    Standort      = as.factor(Standort),
    Zeitpunkt     = as.factor(Zeitpunkt),
    Gruppe        = as.factor(Gruppe),
    Sex           = as.factor(Sex),
    CpG_position  = as.factor(CpG_position),
    CogTel        = as.numeric(CogTel),
    rauchen       = as.factor(rauchen),
    methylierung  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(methylierung))
  )
```

```{r}
bdnf_subset %>% tabyl(Standort, Zeitpunkt) %>% adorn_totals(c("row","col"))

```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(flextable)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# ---- 1) Subject × Zeitpunkt summary (avg across CpGs) -----------------------
# Keep Zeitpunkte ordered nicely (T0, T1, T2 if present; otherwise observed order)
maybe_levels <- c("T0","T1","T2")
z_levels <- intersect(maybe_levels, unique(as.character(bdnf_subset$Zeitpunkt)))
if (length(z_levels) == 0) z_levels <- unique(as.character(bdnf_subset$Zeitpunkt))

sub_tp <- bdnf_subset %>%
  mutate(Zeitpunkt = factor(as.character(Zeitpunkt), levels = z_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt) %>%
  summarise(
    methylierung = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standort = dplyr::first(na.omit(Standort)),
    Gruppe   = dplyr::first(na.omit(Gruppe)),
    Sex      = dplyr::first(na.omit(Sex)),
    rauchen  = dplyr::first(na.omit(rauchen)),
    Age_start= suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(Age_start))),
    CogTel   = suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(CogTel))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Optional: tertiles for continuous covariates so they can appear as "rows"
sub_tp <- sub_tp %>%
  mutate(
    Age_start_tertile = if (sum(!is.na(Age_start)) >= 3) ntile(Age_start, 3) else NA_integer_,
    CogTel_tertile    = if (sum(!is.na(CogTel))    >= 3) ntile(CogTel, 3)    else NA_integer_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_start_tertile = factor(Age_start_tertile, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")),
    CogTel_tertile    = factor(CogTel_tertile,    labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
  )

# ---- 2) Build the single cross-table ---------------------------------------
row_vars <- c("Standort", "Gruppe", "Sex", "rauchen", "Age_start_tertile", "CogTel_tertile")
row_vars <- intersect(row_vars, names(sub_tp))  # keep only what exists

fmt_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("—")
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)\n(n=%d)", mean(x), sd(x), n)
}

# Compute stats for each variable level × Zeitpunkt
long_rows <- map_dfr(row_vars, function(v) {
  sub_tp %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(Variable = v, Level = .data[[v]], Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(Stat = fmt_cell(methylierung), .groups = "drop")
})

# Wide table with Zeitpunkt as columns, Variable/Level as rows
xtab <- long_rows %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Zeitpunkt, values_from = Stat) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Level)

# ---- 3) Flextable (prints in RStudio Viewer) --------------------------------
ft <- flextable(xtab) |>
  set_caption("Methylierung (mean (SD), n) by categories (rows) and Zeitpunkt (columns)") |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all")

print(ft, preview = "viewer")

```
